title: Underwriting policy snapshot
description: Machine mirror of policy.yaml with hashes, so the site's threshold table can never drift from what the run actually used. Section anchors let the pair viewer deep-link a threshold to its prose in policy.md.

synthetic.description: Always true. This is a synthetic lender policy against synthetic applicants; the project never claims to replicate any real lender's underwriting.

prohibited_tools.description: Calling one of these is a policy violation regardless of the decision reached -- the tau2-bench pattern: task completed plus policy violated equals FAIL.

max_stated_reasons.description: Regulation B guidance: disclosing more than four reasons is not likely to be helpful. The submit_decision tool schema deliberately allows more, because exceeding it is itself a finding and enforcing it in the schema would hide the finding.
